⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Exceptional Service from Amy – Pets at Home Sheldon
I can’t praise Amy enough! From the very moment I walked into the Sheldon Pets at Home store, she greeted me with such genuine warmth and friendliness that it instantly made my day. I asked if I could leave some items on the counter while I picked up a few more, and without hesitation she smiled and said, “No problem at all!” — a small gesture that made my shopping experience so much easier.
Later, when I was trying to sign into the Pets at Home app at the till, she noticed I was struggling and patiently waited, offering help without a hint of rush or frustration. And then, seeing me juggling all my bags, she took the initiative on her own to help carry everything out to my car — I was honestly blown away!
Amy truly went above and beyond, showing genuine care and compassion from start to finish. I’ve been visiting Pets at Home for years, but I’ve never experienced such outstanding customer service. She puts the customer at the heart of everything she does and represents the company’s values perfectly.
Amy deserves real recognition for her kindness, initiative, and exceptional service — Pets at Home is incredibly lucky to have her!
